fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (1987 Lund aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer).
findings: Grime and dirt staining on the carpeted front deck floor near the bow
Dirty, scuffed interior surfaces along the bow casting deck and side walls
Dirt and staining on the forward bench and storage lids
Faded, weathered vinyl on the driver seat and passenger seats
Dull, uneven finish along the painted aluminum hull sides
Light dust and water spotting on the black Mercury cowling
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund Pro Alaskan. The front deck floor and the interior walls look like they've seen a lot of good fishing and duck seasons, and a cleanup there plus a wash and wax on the hull and motor cowl would help it show well in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
